text:
Sam (Sales): ACME wants to shrink their Dedicated POC pool (ded-poc-acme-11) for the Friday demo to cut costs. Current commit min_capacity=30, burst_window=2h. Request: min_capacity=10, burst_window=25m, plus 75 ephemeral burst credits. They also need a short-lived API key scoped to the demo with IP allowlist. Can infra do ephemeral overlay instead of altering the contract? Need confirmation today.

Priya (Infra): We can apply an ephemeral overlay (quota overlay) without changing the underlying reservation, but note: billing will reflect ephemeral usage as overage. Burst window 25m OK. Recommend cooldown 15m to avoid oscillation.

Liam (Eng): Proposed pool patch:
{"min_capacity":"10","burst_window":"25m","cooldown":"15m","ephemeral_credits":"75","fallback_route":"hosted-small"}
Also add an alert: 75% sustained for 3m -> page on-call.

ops-bot: [automated] Ticket POC-6122 created. Status: awaiting-approval.

marco-acme (ACME): We accept potential overage for the demo and TTL=48h for the key with IP allowlist. Please proceed.

Sam (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral overlay and billing exposure for the demo only. Priya, schedule T-2h change window and post runbook.

Priya (Infra): Will do. Rollback command included in runbook. Scheduling change window now and will update ticket POC-6122.

ops-bot: [automated] POC-6122 status -> scheduled. Change window: 2026-05-01T15:00Z -> 2026-05-01T17:00Z.

Sam (Sales): Thanks team! Ill confirm demo time with ACME. :thumbsup:
